{{Top|leg}}
The '''Czerka Phase Three Adrenal Combat Enhancers''' was a combat enhancement boost developed by the [[Czerka Interstellar]] during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="Research and Destruction">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=event|Galactic Season 8: Research and Destruction}}</ref> The combat enhancers had various effects that provided individuals with special buffs.<ref name="Rising Powers>{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20250310|text=Galactic Season 8 "Rising Powers"}}</ref> Around [[3622 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.6.1}} 7.6.1: Rising Powers can be placed around 3622 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> [[Kai Zykken]] established an uplink with the [[Alliance Commander]] and told the Commander that he had done some informal consulting for Czerka Interstellar and required assistance in testing the combat boosts.<ref name="Research and Destruction" />
